digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — inbound link removal applier
propositions: A removal record for a managed link with no peer confirmation should be declined, logged as WARNING, and not written as an UNLINK event
The confirmation guard must distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones using the peer_confirmations store
A vendor-type collision between a local outbound ADD and a remote inward link in the opposite direction prevents the local ADD from being pushed and leaves its removal unprotected by G4
Removal records for links with confirmed peer synchronization must still converge using relation-scoped UNLINK
An unopenable confirmation store must disable the check entirely and restore pre-story removal behavior (fail-open)
The per-pass INFO summary must report the count of declined removals alongside impossible-link skips
